label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Run it as a service
lede: Pro 2.1.0 adds a ready-to-run admin server, so your customers' admins get the audit log without you building a view. It also brings new alert rules and e-mail alerts.

items.title: Admin server in one container
items.text: Search, filter, export and view the audit log of a tenant in a ready-made admin view. Runs on Postgres, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite and is configured with environment variables only.
items.code:
docker run -p 3000:3000 \
  -e LOGARITHM_DATABASE_URL=postgres://user:pass@db:5432/app \
  -e LOGARITHM_ADMIN_TOKENS="acme=<long random token>,globex=<another one>" \
  -e LOGARITHM_INGEST_KEY=<long random key> \
  -e LOGARITHM_SLACK_WEBHOOK=https://hooks.slack.com/services/... \
  ghcr.io/weber-development/logarithm-server:latest

items.title: Write events from any language
items.text: Apps in PHP, Python, Java or .NET send events over HTTP. The ingest key decides the tenant, and you can send up to 100 events per request.
items.code:
curl -X POST https://audit.example.com/v1/events \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $LOGARITHM_INGEST_KEY" -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"project.updated","actor":{"id":"u_1","name":"Anna Muster"},
       "targets":[{"type":"project","id":"p_1"}],"before":{"name":"A"},"after":{"name":"B"}}'

items.title: Sign in with token, JWT or your proxy
items.text: Admins sign in with a tenant token, an HS256 JWT or the user header of your reverse proxy. Each login sees only its own tenant.
items.code:
# token (default)
LOGARITHM_AUTH=token
LOGARITHM_ADMIN_TOKENS="acme=<token>,globex=<token>"

# HS256 JWT
LOGARITHM_AUTH=jwt
LOGARITHM_JWT_SECRET=<32+ characters>

# trusted proxy header
LOGARITHM_AUTH=proxy
LOGARITHM_PROXY_SECRET=<shared secret>

items.title: More alert rules, and e-mail
items.text: The server checks for unusual activity itself, with no cron job. New rules catch mass changes, permission changes outside working hours and permission changes from a new IP. Alerts go to Slack, Teams, a signed webhook or e-mail.

note: The demo cannot run the server for you. It needs your own database and a container host.
